blocks.text:
Arrive at the airport, where you’ll be met and transferred to your hotel.




Once you’ve checked in, set out on a sightseeing tour of Buenos Aires that lasts about four hours.




The European influence is clear in the city centre. The architecture, mansions and green parks often draw comparisons with Paris.




The route takes you through La Boca and San Telmo, with their many cafés and restaurants. At Plaza Dorrego, you can browse antiques.




Continue to Plaza de Mayo and the Casa Rosada, or Pink House. Your guide will tell you about the city’s history and Evita Perón.




Buenos Aires also has many museums of classical and contemporary art, with works by well-known artists including Rubens and El Greco.




Return to the hotel after the tour.

Estancia Santa Susana and an evening of tango

Breakfast at the hotel.




Then head to Estancia Santa Susana, a gaucho ranch where you’ll learn about rural life on the Argentine pampas and the traditions and customs of the gauchos.




Explore the ranch grounds and enjoy a cultural programme of folk dances and tango.




The highlight is an equestrian show. The gauchos demonstrate their skill with a lasso and ride over obstacles. Guests may be able to join in some interactive parts of the show.




You’ll be served Argentine meat at the end of the visit.




The trip lasts about seven hours. Afterwards, return to Buenos Aires.




In the evening, see a tango show at Tango Porteño. Dinner and drinks are included.




Tango began in the port districts of Buenos Aires and has become one of the city’s defining symbols. The evening features an orchestra, dance performances, Argentine wine and traditional dishes.




Group transfers without a guide are included.



**Schedule:** approximately 20:00 to 23:45.
